## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one cohesive responsibility and preserves inward dependency direction.
- [ ] Every shared item has a named owner, consumer set, version/profile, and conformance path.
- [ ] Files/functions stay within budgets or use a reviewed exact-path exception.
- [ ] Unknown values, rejection, cancellation, and stale-input behavior are explicit.
- [ ] No game, host, transport, gateway, MCP, model, provider, credential, or save behavior was added.
- [ ] No proprietary host file, personal path, credential, or build output is included.
- [ ] No implementation source was copied; dependencies and fixtures have reviewed provenance.
- [ ] Runtime-unverified claims and remaining risks are explicit.
